_comment: Source phrases for the semantic-routing index. Run scripts/generate_search_embeddings.py to (re)build search-embeddings.json. Keep phrases short, varied in phrasing/style, and unambiguous about which destination they imply. Prefer the kind of thing a real user types (lowercase, no punctuation, fragment-style) over polished prose. RULES OF THUMB learned from eval (scripts/eval_routing.py): (1) never add a single generic word as a phrase — under max-pooling it becomes a universal attractor that hijacks unrelated queries ('buy', 'music', 'guide' each caused multiple misroutes); (2) every phrase must be unambiguous about its destination on its own — if a phrase could plausibly belong to two engines, sharpen it or drop it; (3) routing philosophy: ai = the user's chosen AI assistant (Lumo by default) for complicated queries that want a synthesized answer (explain / compare / research / creative writing / agentic deep-dives), ddg = simple facts + navigation + quick lookups, product shopping / 'best X' buying advice for new products = ddg (or ai when it wants a synthesized recommendation), ebay = used / vintage / parts / collectibles, maps = local places + directions, youtube = video + music, images = pictures. x = breaking news, live events, opinions, hot takes and social sentiment ('what are people saying'); ai keeps product reviews, recommendations and advice. Quality-gate any edit with: python3 scripts/eval_routing.py
